Subject: New: The Beacon Headlamp — 400 lumens, 40 hours, 95 grams
Preview: Built for the miles before sunrise and the ones after dark.
Body: You know the drill: alarm at 3 a.m., headlamp goes on before the boots do. The Northbay Beacon is built around that moment.

400 lumens lights up the trail ahead without washing out your peripheral vision. 40 hours of runtime means a weekend trip doesn't require rationing your light. At 95 grams, you won't notice it on your head — until you need it.

It charges via USB-C, so one cable handles your phone and your light. No proprietary charger to forget.

A note on what it's built for: the Beacon handles rain, stream crossings, and camp-sink splashes — the same IPX waterproofing standard we use on our jackets, rated to 20,000mm hydrostatic head. It is not designed for submersion or diving.

No discount, no gimmick. Just a headlamp we'd take out ourselves.
Score 0-1; a score below 0.75 is a fail.
